baseline: Exact cumulative Cut16 archive from conversation; new source differs only in documented Cut17 improvements
provenance: Cut16 browser_cut17.py red, Cut17 green; Node pure helper assertions; inherited Chromium scripts and headless benchmark; actual pdflatex compilation; local static site checks. NOT hosted deployment.

cases.risk: Zero-opacity nodes and functions still create SVG elements and incur rendering/sampling work
cases.red: Cut16 browser_cut17.py failed at invisible node DOM assertion
cases.fix: Skip alpha-zero objects before resolver paths and SVG construction
cases.green: Cut17 browser_cut17.py checks rendered SVG absence and editable JSON preservation; inherited Cut04 opacity test updated to stronger representation-invariant contract

cases.risk: Visible morphism to a transparent node reappears in TikZ despite being absent from SVG
cases.red: Baseline canTikz() checks hidden but not zero-opacity endpoints
cases.fix: Disable TikZ when a visible morphism has an invisible endpoint
cases.green: Cut17 Chromium TikZ option disabled; SVG morphism also absent

cases.risk: Transparent morphism exported as residual TikZ arrow
cases.red: Cut16 asTikz() only excludes hidden objects, not opacity zero
cases.fix: TikZ emits only visible objects and edges
cases.green: Cut17 actual downloaded TikZ text has neither transparent edge nor its label

cases.risk: Thousands of fully offscreen bounded SVG shapes monopolize DOM and redraw time
cases.red: Cut16 fixed synthetic scene 2920 SVG id nodes; median redraw 20.45ms
cases.fix: Conservative screen-space bbox/radius culling of bounded primitives; model retained
cases.green: Cut17 synthetic scene 720 SVG id nodes, median 6.30ms; viewport-crossing and near-edge segment browser assertions

cases.risk: Culling incorrectly hides wide/curved/stroked geometry near or crossing canvas
cases.red: Adversarial crossing endpoints and circle-radius geometry added before acceptance
cases.fix: Bézier control hull, circle radius, stroke margin and conservative nonfinite fallback
cases.green: Cut17 5 Node tests plus actual Chromium crossing/near-edge SVG checks

cases.risk: Old test assumed invisible SVG label must remain in DOM with alpha 0
cases.red: Retained browser_cut04_opacity.py failed after deliberate stronger optimization
cases.fix: Update historical test contract to absence in rendered/exported SVG and TikZ
cases.green: Cut17 standalone opacity suite passes; preserves non-hit-test requirements
